title: Doha NO2 z>1 leads TTF +3d (long reversal)
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Doha CAMS NO2 20d z-score > 1 (reversal control: Ras Laffan activity proxy was a losing short in the war test) leads TTF log returns by 3 days (+); trade long TTF=F 3d [airquality.doha.cams_no2 -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0028)

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.doha.cams_no2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Doha CAMS NO2 20d z-score > 1 (spread control: Doha NO2 -> TTF long was flat full-sample, +0.7%/trade OOS only) leads TTF/Henry Hub ratio log change by 3 days (+); trade long finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub 3d [airquality.doha.cams_no2 -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub] (parent: R2-0126)
